_comment: Ep.002 — 'The Fourteen Minutes'. REWRITTEN 2026-09-16 as a story-driven script (specific loss -> universal reframe -> mechanism -> proof -> punch -> indicting CTA) rather than a stat-listicle. Numbers are placeholders — replace with real data before recording.

cues.text: A six hundred fifty thousand dollar buyer called this agency. Nobody picked up.
Fourteen minutes later, he called the office next door instead. Seventy-eight percent of buyers go with whoever answers first.
So instead of hiring someone to sit by the phone all day, we gave the phone a brain. The second a call is missed, it acts.
Watch. It texts back in under ten seconds, asks the two questions that actually matter, budget and timeline, and locks in a showing before he even thinks about calling anyone else.
That's a full-time coordinator's job, done before your coffee gets cold. Six showings a week that used to just evaporate, booked automatically.
Still paying someone to sit by the phone and hope? Comment SYSTEM. I'll send you the exact blueprint.
